text: Choose a single high-contrast dark theme as default with adjustable saturation. This maximizes visibility and reduces eye strain in low light, aligning with our goal of clarity and enjoyment. name: Facet
text:
Do: Default to a single high-contrast dark theme with a persistent, one-click light mode toggle that remembers user choice.

Why: This keeps the benefits of dark mode—visibility, reduced eye strain, and alignment with our goal of clarity and enjoyment—while removing the permanent exclusion risk. The toggle costs almost nothing to implement and respects individual needs without fragmenting the design.

Trade-off: Slightly less visual uniformity, but the data shows users value accessibility over aesthetic consistency.

name: Lumen

DECISION: Default to a single high-contrast dark theme with a temporary light mode override (resets on refresh) to balance visibility, accessibility, and liveliness.

Result: A dark interface that remains the default but offers a one-time light mode escape hatch, ensuring no user is permanently locked out while preserving the core experience. Owned by visualization.
